pwa.modal_desc: If the install prompt does not appear automatically, use the browser menu to install FaunaNusantara.ai like a regular app.
pwa.android_step1: Open the browser menu from the three-dot button.
pwa.android_step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
pwa.android_step3: Confirm the install, then open FaunaNusantara.ai from the app icon.
pwa.ios_step2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the browser.
pwa.ios_step3: Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
pwa.desktop_step1: Open FaunaNusantara.ai in Chrome, Edge, or another PWA-capable browser.
pwa.desktop_step2: Look for the install icon in the address bar or open the browser menu.
pwa.desktop_step3: Choose Install FaunaNusantara.ai and confirm the installation.
